title: Sicily, in November: the sea cave, the lemons, then the table

brief.audience: American travellers dreaming of and planning a stay in Sicily; guests of villas and boats around Palermo
brief.objective: Saves, sends and profile visits from people planning a stay
brief.hook: One calm sea cave in Sicily with the place and the month, nothing else: a place worth sending to whoever is travelling with you.

brief.hypothesis: A piece that opens on the sea of Sicily in November earns more saves and sends than one that opens on a plate. Success: saves plus shares >= 3% of reach.
